description: The canonical map from integers to fraction classes is injective and preserves addition, multiplication, zero, one, and order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.integer_rational_embedding :
  (Function.Injective fun z => Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑z) ∧
    (∀ (a b : ℤ),
        Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalAdd
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑a)
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑b) =
          Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑(a + b)) ∧
      (∀ (a b : ℤ),
          Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalMul
              (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑a)
              (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑b) =
            Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑(a * b)) ∧
        (∀ (a b : ℤ),
            Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.RationalLE
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑a)
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat ↑b) ↔
              a ≤ b) ∧
          Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalValue
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat 0) =
              0 ∧
            Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalValue
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalOfRat 1) =
              1
